context: Sakura interviews a historian about a documentary on national history.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: historian interview; formal/abstract vocabulary in natural home.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先生、この時代における国家の役割、教えてください。
lines.en: Professor, please tell me the state's role in this era.
lines.style: gentle adult writer voice, soft warm professional inquiry delivered carefully

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 資料から、その役割は明らかになっています。
lines.en: From the records, that role has become clear.
lines.style: measured scholar-mode boss voice, soft warm informative delivery carefully

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 一部の記録は、失われたんですか?
lines.en: Were some of the records lost?
lines.style: curious adult writer voice, soft warm engaged delivery carefully

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ええ、その点は、研究者も指摘しています。
lines.en: Yes — researchers point that out too.
lines.style: soft scholar voice, warm warm clear delivery carefully

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 深い歴史ですね、本当に。
lines.style: tender adult writer voice, soft warm reverent delivery carefully

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 次の世代に、伝えたい話です。
lines.en: It's a story I want to pass to the next generation.
lines.style: warm scholar voice, soft warm earnest delivery carefully

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: I'll write it with all my heart.
lines.style: humble adult writer voice, soft warm committed delivery carefully
